desc.root: Install architectures, not dependencies: code + AI rules + MCP config from immutable Git commits.
desc.add: Inject one or more packages (and their GenPM dependencies) into this project
desc.info: Show a package: manifest, dependencies, MCP, env vars and its AI rules
desc.list: List installed packages and local changes (drift)
desc.outdated: Show installed packages with newer versions
desc.audit: Verify integrity, signatures, advisories and yanked versions
desc.doctor: Check your environment and this project
desc.init: Create genpm.json, AGENTS.md and .genpmignore in a package repo
desc.validate: Validate a package before publishing (same scanner as the registry)
desc.publish: Publish the current Git tag to the registry
desc.yank: Withdraw a published version (it stays immutable and is never re-published)
desc.logout: Log out and revoke the token
desc.mcpServe: Run the GenPM MCP server over stdio (what your AI client launches)
desc.mcpSetup: Register the GenPM MCP server in your AI client
desc.mcpAdd: Write the MCP servers declared by an installed package
desc.mcpRemove: Remove the MCP servers declared by an installed package
desc.cache: Show or clean the download cache
desc.upgrade: Update the standalone genpm binary to the latest release

arg.yes: Accept code-injection prompts (does not imply --mcp or --install-deps)
arg.lang: Output language (en, es, pt-BR, fr, de, ja, zh-CN, ko)
arg.dest: Install into another directory (single package only)
arg.dryRun: Show the plan and exit without writing
arg.noMcp: Do not write MCP config nor ask
arg.installDeps: Run the proposed package-manager command without asking
arg.noInstallDeps: Do not run the package-manager command nor ask
arg.force: Overwrite a non-empty destination (backs it up first)
arg.maxSize: Size limit per package in MB
arg.name: Package name, e.g. @core/auth
arg.keepCode: Keep the code; only forget the package
arg.exitCode: Exit with code 4 if something is outdated
arg.ref: Tag or full SHA to publish
arg.client: claude | cursor | vscode | windsurf | codex | gemini
arg.workflow: Also create a GitHub Actions workflow that publishes on v* tags
arg.check: Only check whether a newer version exists
